meta.name: Classical · centered · arbitrary width · inverse-polynomial error
meta.regime: One centered sample; (1+1/f(n),2^{-f(n)}) accuracy for polynomial f
meta.rules: For any positive width, produce a distribution within 2^{-f(n)} of a pointwise (1+1/f(n))-multiplicative approximation. f is polynomial, so implied total-variation accuracy is inverse polynomial. Do not merge with negligible-error DGS without a separate argument.
